capacity_gross_kwh.notes: OpenEV Data 2024/2025: gross 82 kWh (relayed from tesla.com/modely per its record); ArenaEV 82 total agrees.
Estimated: ArenaEV "82 kWh total" for the Model Y LR AWD 2021-2025.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV 82 total / 75 usable and EV Database 75 usable (both for 2021-2025) and the Model 3 Panasonic pack (82/76) agree on about 75; OpenEV Data lists 79 net, the odd one out, so it is not used here. One pack is given to every id of the same rated hardware (2024 LR AWD plain, -ca and -i rate 496-498 km at 178 Wh/km; 2023/2024 Performance ids rate 459 km at 192 Wh/km) because the sources do not show a build or market difference between them.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs: Panasonic 2170 cells (NCA) for California-built Model 3/Y; one chemistry across the Fremont line. OpenEV Data lists these cars as nmc (Panasonic), so naming conflicts. Build site of the -ca and -i ids is not shown by any page, so they follow the same line.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV lists a 360 V (400 V-type) pack for the same Model Y LR AWD; OpenEV Data also 400v.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Teslabs (2025-01) says no manual battery-preconditioning control exists, only navigating to a charger; EV Database listings say the battery is warmed automatically when navigating to a charger. Tesla manuals were not fetchable (403). Navigation preconditioning is an over-the-air software feature across Tesla models; Teslabs gives no model years. Tesla manuals were not readable (403). A Scheduled Precondition and Charge setting exists (seen in search excerpts of the Model Y manual), and one June 2025 Teslabs comment (Model 3) says the app can start battery warming with a Supercharger selected; no Tesla page shows a dedicated manual battery-preconditioning control, so automatic_with_navigation is kept.

Estimated: Listing for the same model family says preconditioning is possible and starts automatically when navigating to a charger. Combined with the Teslabs no-manual-control statement. dc_max_kw.notes: OpenEV Data 2024/2025: 250 kW; ArenaEV and EV Database agree.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Thechargeport puts the non-Standard Model Y trims at the 11.5 kW end of the 7.7-11.5 kW range (North America); Wikipedia: up to 11.5 kW AC on all variants. EU listings quote 11 kW 3-phase, not used.
Estimated: Wikipedia: all Model Y variants support up to 11.5 kW AC.
